# `pval2stars()` {#fn-pval2stars}

**Validation on 2.0.9005.** All tested symbol thresholds, their equality cases and the legacy printed bound agreed with their stated probability ranges. [S03 results](s03-scoring-checks.qmd).

[Function index](function-index.html#idx-pval2stars)

```{=html}
<p>Use a symbol for compact plot labels while retaining the numeric p-value for
interpretation. The cut points are 0.001, 0.01, 0.05 and 0.1, with symbols ***, **, *, +
and an open circle in order of increasing p. An equality belongs to the interval ending at that cut
point. For legacy strings beginning with a less-than sign and space, the function
classifies the printed bound. It does not calculate a test or adjust for multiple
comparisons.
</p>
```

[Interpreting the global and adjusted local results](fn-plot-skyscaper-sigtest.qmd).
